new.s: In which year was the Industrial Finance Corporation of India (IFCI), the first development finance institution, set up?
new.x: IFCI was set up on 1 July 1948 by a special Act; it was India's first DFI and its setting up began the era of development financing.
new.angle: U0523 #1 DFI -> year (IFCI); PYQ y1b49a24340e era of development financing

new.s: Which was the second all-India term-lending institution to be set up in India?
new.x: IFCI (1948) was the first all-India term-lending institution and ICICI (1955) the second.
new.angle: U0523 PYQ y133f285761e first/second all-India financial institution

new.s: In which year was the Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank) set up?
new.x: EXIM Bank was set up in January 1982 to finance exports and imports; it is headquartered in Mumbai.
new.angle: U0523 #1 DFI -> year + sector (EXIM Bank)

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IFCI, ICICI and IDBI all provided medium and long-term industrial finance.
2. IFCI was set up in 1964 under the RBI.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: IFCI, ICICI and IDBI all gave medium and long-term industrial finance. IFCI was set up in 1948; it was IDBI that was set up in 1964 under the RBI.
new.angle: U0523 #9 long-term industrial finance providers; PYQ y6c79bdd7510

new.s: In which type of financial institution did the default of IL&FS in September 2018 take place?
new.x: IL&FS was an infrastructure NBFC; its defaults in September 2018 set off a liquidity crisis among NBFCs (shadow lenders).
new.angle: U0523 PYQ y72ca282b9b2 shadow lender crisis -> NBFCs

new.s: In which of the following is Foreign Direct Investment prohibited in India?
new.x: FDI is prohibited in chit funds and Nidhi companies, which belong to the unorganised segment; insurance, banking and pensions allow FDI within limits.
new.angle: U0523 PYQ y758d8722637 FDI prohibited -> chit funds/nidhis

new.s: In which year was the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) set up?
new.x: LIC was set up in 1956, before UTI (1964) and GIC (1972).
new.angle: U0523 #7 insurance institutions -> year (LIC)

new.s: In which year was the credit-rating agency CARE set up?
new.x: CARE was set up in 1993; CRISIL came in 1987 and ICRA in 1991.
new.angle: U0523 #7 credit-rating institutions -> year (CARE)

new.s: Which institution provides development and refinance support for loans to micro units?
new.x: MUDRA Bank gives development and refinance support for loans to micro units; NHB is for housing, EXIM for trade and NaBFID for infrastructure.
new.angle: U0523 notes gap MUDRA Bank -> role

new.s: Which category of NBFC, introduced by the RBI in 2017, runs online platforms for peer-to-peer lending?

new.angle: U0523 notes gap NBFC categories -> NBFC-P2P

new.s: The National Housing Bank was set up on the advice of a high-level group headed by whom?

new.s: Which institution acts as the quasi-regulator of State Financial Corporations?

new.angle: U0523 #2 AIFIs role; notes gap SIDBI -> SFCs

new.angle: U0524 #2 Establishment -> Hilton Young Commission; PYQ y61cd6e7eb9a

new.s: By what other name was the Hilton Young Commission known?

new.angle: U0524 #9 recommending commission -> name

new.s: What is the rate at which the RBI lends to commercial banks or rediscounts their bills called?

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a contingent function of money?
new.x: Medium of exchange is a primary function; basis of credit, distribution of national income and giving liquidity are contingent functions.
new.angle: U0525 #15 functions of money -> what is not; PYQ y4948ecb925a

new.s: Bank money, as distinct from cash, is also known as which type of money?
new.x: Bank money is secondary money, while cash is high-powered money; together currency and deposit money make up money supply.
new.angle: U0525 PYQ yaef98a578c2 money supply = currency + deposit money

new.s: What is the fixed percentage of deposits that every bank must keep as reserves called?
new.x: The Required Reserve Ratio is the fixed share of deposits every bank must keep as reserves.
new.angle: U0525 PYQ y612b77e955d Required Reserve Ratio

new.s:
Consider the following statements about an increase in the Cash Reserve Ratio:
1. Banks have less money to lend.
2. The money multiplier rises.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: A higher CRR parks more bank money with the RBI, so banks have less to lend and the money multiplier falls.
new.angle: U0525 #5 multiplier and CRR; PYQ ya031d3597a9

new.s: If the supply of money remains fixed and the demand for money falls, what happens to the rate of interest?
o: It first rises and then falls
new.x: With fixed money supply, a rise in money demand raises the interest rate and a fall in demand lowers it.
new.angle: U0525 #16 demand shifts -> effect on interest rate

new.s: Which Act ended the liability on the old ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes after the 2016 demonetisation?
o: Specified Bank Notes (Cessation of Liabilities) Act, 2017
Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act
new.x: The Specified Bank Notes (Cessation of Liabilities) Act, 2017 followed the 2016 demonetisation; the High Denomination Act was for 1978.
new.angle: U0525 #12 demonetisation enabling law (notes gap)

new.s: The e-Rupee (CBDC) is a direct liability of which institution?
new.x: The e-Rupee is legal tender and a direct liability of the RBI, whereas UPI money is a liability of banks.
new.angle: U0525 #9 CBDC -> nature (notes gap)

new.s: In 2026, where was the Digital Food Currency pilot using the e-Rupee launched?
new.x: The Digital Food Currency pilot based on the e-Rupee was launched in Puducherry in 2026.
new.angle: U0525 #9 CBDC pilot (notes gap)

new.s: Under which Act was decimal coinage introduced in India from 1 April 1957?
o: Indian Coinage and Paper Currency Act, 1899
new.x: Decimal coinage came on 1 April 1957 under the Indian Coinage (Amendment) Act, 1955, with ₹1 = 100 naye paise.
new.angle: U0525 #13 decimal coinage -> law

new.s: What was the policy repo rate after the MPC meeting of 5 August 2026?

new.angle: U0526 #1 instruments -> current rate (SDF)
